Spec says D1 SS54 series between external 5V and +5V; D2 PMEG3030EP from +5V into servo rail. Netlist D1 value PMEG3030EP, D3 SS54. Refs swapped? Capacitors: spec C1-C4 100u bulk on servo rail, C5 0.1u on +3V3. Netlist C1,C2,C3,C7 100u on servo rail (Net-(D1-K) to GND) four caps; C6 0.1u +3V3. Good.

MAX3485: spec U1, Q2 BC857, R1 10k, R2 5.1k, R6 2k, R7 20k, R8/R15 2.2k. Netlist U2 MAX3485, Q3 BC857, R1 5.1k, R3 10k, R6 20k, R4 2k, R16/R17 2.2k. Need map.
